head.name: Track Diagram Counted
what: serif title with a typed count in the page colour standing on the masthead rule; wild-1 uses a huge thin section numeral
Serif title with a page-coloured typed count and unit beside it, standing on the masthead rule

head.name: Swiss Thread
what: Huge thin numeral in the section colour with a flush-left bold title and grey lede; or the drafting title block with SHEET, NOTE, DO and NO. cells and the primary key in it
flush-left bold grotesque title leading the page with a grey lede and section-coloured numeral; count beside the title as runner

head.name: Signal Catalogue, Counted
what: large typed count figure beside the plate with brass unit and a pencilled line; or 48px title with the page's one action at the right end
Page title plate with a large typed count and unit beside it

glass.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Next up tube sitting on the rail with a faint scale below, plus a lit status line under the question

glass.name: Desk Terminal, Joined
what: one tube holding the VERA line, Next up, scope and the typed question in VT323

list.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
what: To do as a dated spine with nodes and a lit NOW; faint alternate-row band as a runner

list.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Coming up as dated plates hanging from a lit NOW rail; To do as dotted rail with the due time in the margin

list.name: Track Diagram Aglow
what: dated rail with stamps at each row and a lit now node; or faint steel banding on alternate rows

figure.name: Desk Terminal, Joined
what: moving-coil spend dial in phosphor with a limit mark on the Status tube, with the $0.00 VT323 readout

figure.name: Grid Console Gauged
what: Moving-coil spend gauge on a tube, lit needle with a ghost average-day needle

figure.name: Long Persistence
what: due scope on To do (late spikes, now line, week divisions); or the round week dial with today lit

rule.name: Grid Console, merged
what: Section head as a serif title and icon on a thin rail in the section's colour

rule.name: Blueprint, Pencilled Ends
what: Section rule ending in a solid coloured block, in the section's pencil; or a titled rule trailing a lit rail

signal.name: Track Diagram Aglow, merged
what: lit nodes strung on a vertical rail; the lamp status line under the question

signal.name: Tallied Lamp Line
what: one mono lamp line under the question saying what Vera is doing and whether anything waits

type.name: Swiss Thread
what: Inter with an optical size, huge thin section numerals, Geist Mono small caps at 0.72rem; or light Fraunces figures a size above their text

type.name: Track Diagram Folio
what: Fraunces titles and section heads, light lining figures, small-caps units
Fraunces heads with light lining figures and small-cap units; a larger page title with the action at its end

type.name: Folio Dial, Ready Line
what: Fraunces display serif page titles at large optical size over mono labels and sans body

colour.name: Track Diagram Counted
what: Teal-black ground with warm cream ink, plus thin section-coloured lines and sage and cyan companions

colour.name: Blueprint, Pencilled Ends
what: Green-black glass in a steel-slate case, with each sheet's hairlines drawn in its own pencil colour (cyan, violet, pink, amber)

colour.name: Desk Terminal, Banded
what: slightly cooler ground with warmer bone neutral words; walnut and brass plate material as runner

controls.name: Desk Terminal, Serif Keys
what: raised graphite select key with a steel chevron that flips open onto a plain plate list, plus a brighter raised Send

controls.name: Phosphor Blueprint, merged
what: Show filter as a row of lit-dot keys with a squared search field and Filter key

controls.name: Track Diagram Weekdial
what: Select drawn as a raised button with a chevron that flips open; a clean list; bright Send key

chat.name: Folio Dial, Ready Line
what: Thread hanging from Vera's mark, opening on a headed question with 'mind' lit and times in the margin

chat.name: Grid Console Single Line
what: one panel with bold question and lit key word, a From bar with mic and Send, then compact outlined starters

chat.name: Track Diagram Folio
what: Thread hung on a rail that opens on What's on your mind? as its first stop, with Vera's lines on nodes

light.name: Grid Console Single Line
what: three-layer halo on the one lit word 'mind' in the Home panel, bright Send, halo kept for the live word only

light.name: Grid Console Gauged
what: White-hot NOW lamp on a lit rail, a footer pilot lamp, and a halo only on the live words

foot.name: Desk Terminal, Rule-Marked
what: phone tab bar with the current page marked by a short coloured rule under its label; keyed tab bar as runner

foot.name: Grid Console Gauged
what: A single pilot lamp lit on the footer horizon with a lit run either side; or a numbered top bar with a lit segment under the mark

foot.name: Desk Terminal, Mapped
what: Phone tab bar with a steel reverse block marking the here-tab, large icons and labels
